_note: Built-in sales / CRM preset — for pipeline and deal-assist agents that must reflect a deal's CURRENT state, not a stale snapshot (complements the support preset, which covers post-sale accounts). Enable with VAYL_SLOT_SCHEMA=preset:sales. Nothing is confirm-gated: deal facts move fast and should apply immediately. Deal state is single-valued (a new value supersedes the old — a stage moving to negotiation retires 'qualified'); stakeholders, competitors, objections, next steps, and requirements are lists.

slots.name: deal_stage
slots.description: the opportunity's current pipeline stage (e.g. prospecting, qualified, proposal, negotiation, closed-won, closed-lost)

slots.name: deal_value
slots.description: the deal's value / annual contract value

slots.name: economic_buyer
slots.description: the person with budget authority who signs off

slots.name: primary_contact
slots.description: the main point of contact at the account

slots.name: account_owner
slots.description: the sales rep who owns this account / deal

slots.name: current_vendor
slots.description: the incumbent solution the prospect uses today (the one to displace)

slots.name: lead_source
slots.description: where the lead / opportunity originated (e.g. inbound, referral, event, outbound)

slots.name: stakeholder
slots.description: a person involved in the deal and their role (e.g. 'Priya — champion') — a deal has several

slots.name: competitor
slots.description: a competitor being evaluated in this deal (a deal may face several)

slots.name: objection
slots.description: a raised objection, blocker, or risk to the deal (several may be open)

slots.name: next_step
slots.description: an agreed next step or action item to advance the deal (several may be open)

slots.name: requirement
slots.description: a stated need, use case, or must-have the prospect requires (a deal has several)
